title: I Am the Digestive Fire
translation: Becoming Vaishvanara, the fire of life, I dwell in the bodies of living beings. Joined with the in-breath and out-breath, I digest the four kinds of food.
translation_hi: मैं वैश्वानर अग्नि बनकर प्राणियों के शरीर में रहता हूँ, और प्राण तथा अपान वायु से युक्त होकर चार प्रकार के अन्न को पचाता हूँ।
science: Digestion really is a slow 'fire': cells burn food with the oxygen we breathe in and release carbon dioxide that we breathe out. Breathing and digestion work together, just as the verse says.
